analysis.reasonEn: Previous buy decision held for 4 consecutive sessions. RSI dropped from 58.7 to 51.9 but remains above 50 in neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from 0.0032 to 0.1088, strengthening the uptrend. The 5-day low of $69.53 is higher than the 20-day low of $66.94, indicating the early stages of a Higher Low pattern recovery. Price is above SMA20 at $69.81, confirming support.
